sources.title: Touch target size — Android Accessibility Help
verified_facts: Recommended touch target at least 48x48 dp
Recommended separation at least 8 dp
Visible icon and touch target can differ; enlarged targets must not overlap

sources.title: Playables design best practices — Google for Developers
verified_facts: 48x48 dp target with 8 dp spacing
Differentiate button states and hierarchy
Small text contrast 4.5:1; larger text contrast 3:1
Adapt canvas and UI across sizes

sources.title: Layout — Apple Human Interface Guidelines
sources.retrieval: official markdown using HTTPS curl after HTML linked it
verified_facts: Group and align content by importance
Use progressive disclosure
Landscape-only games still need adaptable layouts
System/hardware safe areas must protect important content and controls

sources.title: Accessibility — Apple Human Interface Guidelines
verified_facts: Current iOS/iPadOS control size table: recommended default 44x44 pt; minimum 28x28 pt
Current iOS/iPadOS text table: default 17 pt; minimum 11 pt
sources.caveat: These are current source table labels, not a recommendation to use minimum sizes for dense Chinese game UI.

sources.title: Support different pixel densities — Android Developers
verified_facts: Use density-independent layout units
Text sp responds to font preferences
Raster pixels and physical/control sizes are different
